MeshyRiggingMultiAnimationInput.description:
Input for the standalone multi-clip animation endpoint.

Auto-rigs a humanoid GLB model and generates multiple animation clips
against that single rig — one clip per ID in ``animation_action_ids``.
Unlike the per-generator endpoints (which apply a single optional
animation), this endpoint is dedicated to producing several clips at once.

animation_action_ids.description: Animation preset IDs from Meshy's library. One animation clip is generated per ID against the same rig and returned in the 'animations' output array, in request order. Must contain at least one ID. Each ID must be in [0, 696], at most 10 distinct clips may be requested, and duplicate IDs are de-duplicated. See https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library for available IDs.
animation_action_ids.title: Animation Action Ids

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input data will be checked for safety before processing.

height_meters.title: Height Meters

include_fingers.description: Rig the character's fingers. Works with any skeleton template.
include_fingers.title: Include Fingers

model_url.description: URL of a 3D model in GLB format to rig and animate. Can be any publicly accessible URL — works with models generated by Hunyuan, Trellis, Meshy, or any other 3D generation tool. The model must be a humanoid character with clearly defined limbs.
model_url.title: Model Url

skeleton_template.description: Skeleton template for the rig. Animations made from the rig use the same skeleton. Leave unset for Meshy's default skeleton (meshyrig). Some models can only be rigged on meshyrig without fingers; those requests fail with a 422.
skeleton_template.title: Skeleton Template

x-fal-metadata.about:
Auto-rig a 3D humanoid model and generate multiple animation clips.

Like /rigging, but dedicated to producing several animation clips from
a single rig in one request. Each preset ID in ``animation_action_ids``
becomes an independent Meshy animation task (run concurrently against
the shared rig) and is returned as a separate entry in the
``animations`` output array, in request order.

Accepts any publicly accessible GLB URL — works with models generated
by Hunyuan, Trellis, Meshy, or any other 3D generation tool.

Features:
- Automatic humanoid rigging with skeleton
- Multiple animation presets applied to one rig in a single call
- Output in both GLB and FBX formats per clip
